title: Crash when selecting material in inspector in 4.5
body:
### Tested versions

4.5 master branch https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/8aa37cab8950351d96f541581abdc42136283f24

### System information

Godot v4.5.beta (8aa37ca) - Void #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat Aug 2 03:38:07 UTC 2025 on Wayland - Wayland display driver, Single-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti Laptop GPU - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i9-12900H (20 threads) - 15.28 GiB memory

### Issue description

This problem did not happen in godot 4.4 but after upgrading to 4.5 it now crashes whenever I select the ShaderMaterial in the editor inspector. This is not for all materials, some materials in some other scenes in my project work perfectly fine but for some reason one ShaderMaterial in particular always crashes when I edit it. This might be the same issue as https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/109734 but im getting slightly different errors so made a separate issue and im also not using the StandardMaterial, mine uses a ShaderMaterial. It also crashes if I try to create remove the current ShaderMaterial and add a new empty one.

I tried looking into the source of the crash but honestly I have no idea what is causing it. It doesn't seem possible for Object::_notification_forward to be the cause of the crash like the backtrace suggests so it must be something somewhere else causing it to crash there.

### Steps to reproduce

Open scene, click on material in MeshInstance3D, cowabunga.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

I have no idea what causes this so can't really make a MRP but the scene my project has this crash on is here if that helps:
https://github.com/dementive/gsg/blob/main/game/scenes/map_editor.tscn. It crashes whenever I edit the map_mesh material.
